## IGramstaxCloudflareModOptions type

`cloudflare-mod` adapter section of `optionsDeploy.serverless`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IGramstaxCloudflareModOptions = {
    name?: string;
    compatibilityDate?: string;
    compatibilityFlags?: string[];
    url?: string;
    secretToken?: string;
    toml?: Record<string, unknown>;
};
```

## Remarks

The adapter is the KEY, so this type only exists under the `cloudflare-mod` key. Fields that do not apply to Cloudflare are absent from this type rather than present-and-ignored.

`compatibilityDate` and `compatibilityFlags` are emitted into `wrangler.toml`<!-- -->. When `undefined` they are written as commented lines carrying the default, so the emitted file documents what would be used.

## Example


```typescript
const section: IGramstaxCloudflareModOptions = {
  name: `gramstax-worker`,
  compatibilityDate: `2026-01-01`,
  compatibilityFlags: [`nodejs_compat`],
  url: `https://example.com/webhook`,
  secretToken: process.env.BOT_WEBHOOK_SECRET ?? ``,
  toml: {account_id: `abc123`}
}
```
